pull_request.title: fix(ci): the HomeSpeaker tool's manifest keeps the layout release-please writes
pull_request.body:
The HomeSpeaker release PR (#3216) cannot go green: its `tidy-check` fails. This fixes that, and stops the next tool from repeating it.

**What went wrong.** When release-please bumps the version in `apps/desktop/home-speaker/tool/vitruvian-tool.json`, it writes the whole file back with every array one item a line. The formatter wants the short form (`["commandBar"]`), so the release PR looks unformatted. The GitHub tool had the same break on its first release (#3198, fixed by #3200). #3211 added a second tool manifest and the fix did not cover it.

**The change.**
- The manifest is committed in release-please's layout and marked `rules-lint-ignored`, as the GitHub tool's is. The content is the same; only whitespace moved.
- Both tools' `version_test` now fail when the manifest is not in that layout. A new tool that copies the test finds this on its own PR, not on its first release.

**Verified.**
- The guard fails on the manifest as it is on `main` and passes on the new one.
- The new file differs from the one release-please wrote on #3216 by the version line alone (`1.12.0` vs `1.13.0`).
- The formatter leaves the new file unchanged (same hash before and after).
- `//apps/desktop/home-speaker:tool_version_test` and `//apps/desktop/vitruvian-tool-github:version_test` pass locally.

**Not verified.** That #3216 goes green. release-please has to rebase it on this merge first.
